answer: Each agent signs the challenge hash from a wallet holding at least 1,000 tokens in 10 minutes, so no hollow claim passes. Verifiers check the signature and read the balance at that block, confirming 1,000 tokens and no reuse, closing the canyon between claim and proof. One honest agent holds 1 wallet for a 150 POA bond; 10 fakes need 10 wallets with 10,000 tokens, so capital cost rises 10X across a nebula of fakes. A bad signature, low balance, or reused wallet slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
